activity.notes: Marie Antoinette became Queen of France when Louis XVI succeeded in 1774. ATLAS ends this representative queen-consort activity with the fall of the monarchy in 1792 and does not model her as a sovereign ruler.

sources.title: Marie-Antoinette — Château de Versailles
sources.citation_text: The Château de Versailles identifies Marie Antoinette as Queen of France and describes her position from Louis XVI's accession in 1774 through the revolutionary collapse of the monarchy in 1792.
